label: water
lines: Water. You have been running on coffee fumes.
A glass of water. It takes twenty seconds.
Hydrate. Your brain is mostly water and it shows.
Go refill something, and actually bring it back.

label: eyes
lines: Twenty seconds looking at something far away.
Eyes off the screen. Find the furthest wall.
Blink on purpose. You had stopped doing it.
Look out a window. Twenty seconds is enough.

label: posture
hint: Sit up straight, while you focus
lines: Sit up. You have folded into the chair again.
Shoulders down, screen at eye level.
Uncross your legs and plant both feet.
Chin back. You are leaning into the monitor.

label: stretch
lines: Stand up. Reach for the ceiling. Sit back down.
Roll your shoulders backwards. Both of them.
Stretch your wrists. You will want them later.
Walk to another room and come back.

label: breathe
lines: Four in, four hold, four out. Twice.
One slow breath, all the way out this time.
Unclench your jaw. Yes, it was clenched.
Breathe out for longer than you breathe in.
